body.en: The bundled agent runtime moves to Synara 1.0.6.
body.zh: 内置的智能体运行时升级到 Synara 1.0.6。

body.en: Typing no longer re-renders the PDF preview on every keystroke.
body.zh: 输入时不再每次按键都重新渲染 PDF 预览。

title.zh: 更清晰的 TODO 面板

body.en: TODOs are grouped by file, with a new illustration when there is nothing left to do.
body.zh: TODO 按文件分组，全部完成时会显示一幅新插图。

title.zh: 更整洁的投稿检查清单

body.en: The figure inventory and limits have more room.
body.zh: 图片清单和篇幅限制有了更宽裕的空间。

body.en: The Review, Find support, Terms and Responses tools have been removed. Data they saved in your projects stays on disk untouched.
body.zh: 审阅、查找支撑文献、术语和审稿回复工具已移除。它们保存在项目中的数据仍原样保留在磁盘上。
